entries.rule_summary: Prefer LE split architecture: aggregate codec driver + SDW transport driver + shared helper libraries.
entries.evidence_of_benefit: Variant 1 improved lifecycle and include alignment while using LE split structure (LIFECYCLE_PATTERN +4.1, INCLUDE_ALIGNMENT +17.79).
entries.evidence_of_risk: Higher structure quality did not prevent downstream derivation warnings in Variant 1; split pattern must not justify LA-near-copy.
conditions: Use LE structure pattern only; prohibit large LA block carryover.
Pair with anti-copy verifier checks in every run.
entries.pm_reason: Benefit is repeatable across variants and does not require runtime evidence when applied as architecture-only guidance.

entries.rule_summary: Drop vendor framework includes/APIs unless there is an LE equivalent.
entries.evidence_of_benefit: Variant 0 showed strong vendor-elimination discipline and no verifier warnings.
entries.evidence_of_risk: Variant 1 regressed VENDOR_ELIMINATION by -71.27 when LA-heavy carryover increased.
conditions: Fail gate when VENDOR_ELIMINATION regresses below agreed threshold.
Require explicit replacement mapping for every removed vendor API.
entries.pm_reason: Rule is correct but must be enforced with stronger penalties to avoid repeat regression.

entries.rule_summary: Use shared wcd-mbhc-v2 and wcd-clsh-v2 patterns instead of codec-local reimplementation.
entries.evidence_of_benefit: WCD938x LA-vs-LE audit shows maintainers accepted shared MBHC/Class-H integration model in LE.
entries.evidence_of_risk: Class-H behavior details remain runtime-sensitive for WCD9378 and cannot be finalized from static learning.
conditions: Reuse shared library interfaces only.
Keep codec-specific Class-H base/version decisions fail-closed until runtime traces.
entries.pm_reason: Integration pattern is reusable; behavior assertions are not.

entries.rule_summary: Map LA DT properties to LE schema names.
entries.evidence_of_benefit: DT coverage remained 100.0 in both variants and transfer candidates recommend checklist promotion.
entries.evidence_of_risk: Property renaming can mask board-specific assumptions unless schema and schematic checks are explicit.
conditions: Require mapping table from every LA DT key to LE schema key or explicit drop rationale.
entries.pm_reason: Low-risk normalization rule with direct evidence and clear quality benefit.

entries.rule_summary: Treat SDW numeric identity as hardware-evidence gated; never infer new codec IDs from siblings.
entries.evidence_of_benefit: WCD9378 learning-impact and evidence packages repeatedly block sibling-ID inference and keep identity unresolved pending logs.
entries.evidence_of_risk: If relaxed, false SDW ID finalization can create irreversible binding errors and invalid runtime claims.
conditions: Require board logs (dmesg/sysfs/modalias) before any SDW numeric identity finalization.
entries.pm_reason: Core fail-closed safety rule; directly tied to unresolved WCD9378 blockers.

entries.rule_summary: Keep runtime-sensitive claims fail-closed until board traces exist.
entries.evidence_of_benefit: Transfer candidates marked this as high-confidence; runtime fail-closed posture stayed intact while score increased.
entries.evidence_of_risk: Without enforcement, high score can be misread as runtime readiness.
conditions: Require explicit runtime blocker register in every RFC/static run.
Block runtime-ready claims unless evidence IDs are linked.
entries.pm_reason: Transfer experiment and WCD9378 validation both show this rule prevents unsafe claims.

entries.rule_summary: Use LE regcache lifecycle (cache-only early; sync on attach/resume).
entries.evidence_of_benefit: WCD938x LE pattern gives stable regmap lifecycle model and improves review consistency.
entries.evidence_of_risk: Paging/controller behavior for WCD9378 remains runtime-unproven, so regcache timing assumptions are partially constrained.
conditions: Apply lifecycle pattern statically, but do not infer paged-register or controller correctness.
Require runtime logs for suspend/resume cache-sync confirmation.
entries.pm_reason: Useful architecture pattern, but runtime behavior must remain evidence-gated.

entries.rule_summary: Normalize IRQ handling to regmap-irq + request_threaded_irq; avoid vendor IRQ wrappers.
entries.evidence_of_benefit: Learning rules report this as structurally desirable in LE style.
entries.evidence_of_risk: Variant 1 marked IRQ rule as NO_EFFECT and no runtime IRQ validation exists.
conditions: Do not enforce as mandatory until additional transfer runs prove impact.
entries.pm_reason: Evidence is currently insufficient for promotion beyond advisory learning context.

entries.rule_summary: Keep DAPM/control categories only with topology evidence; avoid name-only cloning.
entries.evidence_of_benefit: Variant 1 achieved major DAPM improvements across widgets/routes/controls.
entries.evidence_of_risk: Same run also raised downstream similarity warnings, indicating topology gains can come with copy risk.
conditions: Require DAPM category mapping table with LA source and LE structural rationale.
Attach anti-copy verifier results for DAPM-heavy files.
entries.pm_reason: High value for quality, but must be constrained to avoid LA derivation drift.

entries.rule_summary: Use reset via gpiod and regulators via bulk APIs; do not port vendor supply-LPM policy.
entries.evidence_of_benefit: LE pattern is consistent across WCD family and reduces vendor API dependence.
entries.evidence_of_risk: Reset sequencing behavior can still be runtime-sensitive; workaround-style reset hacks remain blocked.
conditions: Allow only LE gpiod/regulator framework migration.
Explicitly ban reset-in-hw_params and re-enumeration recovery hacks.
entries.pm_reason: Reusable for static integration, but runtime semantics remain evidence-gated.

entries.rule_summary: Use LE two-symbol codec/SDW Kconfig pattern when transport split exists.
entries.evidence_of_benefit: Variant learning and prior WCD family audits consistently use split Kconfig/Makefile integration.
entries.evidence_of_risk: Low direct risk; only integration consistency risk if symbols diverge.
conditions: Require symbol naming consistency between Kconfig and Makefile objects.
entries.pm_reason: Compile/integration-oriented rule with stable evidence and low downside.

entries.rule_summary: Ban debug-only artifacts (custom debugfs/hwdep hooks) from conversion output.
entries.evidence_of_benefit: Rule intent matches LE cleanup goals.
entries.evidence_of_risk: Transfer candidate explicitly marked do_not_promote with low confidence because enforcement collapsed under LA-heavy carryover.
conditions: Re-evaluate after adding stronger anti-copy and vendor-elimination gate penalties.
entries.pm_reason: Rule is directionally correct but current implementation evidence is unstable.

entries.rule_summary: Require evidence tags on each transformed subsystem.
entries.evidence_of_benefit: WCD9378 learning-impact validation improved PM quality by explicit area-by-area evidence tagging.
entries.evidence_of_risk: Tagging can become box-checking if not validated against runtime evidence updates.
conditions: Require traceable artifact path per tag.
Fail verifier if runtime-sensitive tag changes without evidence artifact.
entries.pm_reason: Governance-positive rule with modest implementation risk when automated.

entries.rule_summary: When LA and LE disagree and runtime evidence is absent, choose FAIL_CLOSED.
entries.evidence_of_benefit: Transfer candidate and verdict both report stronger PM reliability with fail-closed preference.
entries.evidence_of_risk: No meaningful risk when documented; risk is only accidental override.
conditions: Require PM summary section listing unresolved fail-closed items and prohibited claims.
entries.pm_reason: Directly validated in both WCD9378 and transfer experiment governance results.

entries.rule_summary: Gate check for artifact path mismatches with fallback path suggestions.
entries.evidence_of_benefit: Reduces manual path reconciliation noise during validation and improves replayability.
entries.evidence_of_risk: Low; mainly implementation complexity in gate path resolver.
conditions: Log both requested and resolved artifact paths in gate output.
entries.pm_reason: Tooling-only improvement with no conversion behavior risk.

entries.rule_summary: Scorer/PM rollups should reconcile partial compile artifacts with later full-build artifacts.
entries.evidence_of_benefit: Prevents contradictory compile-state reporting and improves PM decision clarity.
entries.evidence_of_risk: Needs explicit precedence rules to avoid masking intermediate failures.
conditions: Define artifact precedence order and keep raw statuses preserved in report.
entries.pm_reason: Improves observability and avoids misreporting without touching driver behavior.

entries.rule_summary: Prompt template rule forbidding sibling-codec SDW ID inference.
entries.evidence_of_benefit: Directly aligns with unresolved WCD9378 SDW identity blockers and fail-closed governance.
entries.evidence_of_risk: No material downside; may increase NO-GO frequency when hardware evidence is delayed.
conditions: Require explicit hardware evidence reference before any SDW ID claim.
entries.pm_reason: High-priority safeguard and already proven useful in WCD9378 validation.

entries.rule_summary: DT normalization checklist that blocks unresolved LA legacy properties.
entries.evidence_of_benefit: DT mapping consistency stayed stable across transfer variants and improved review quality.
entries.evidence_of_risk: Could over-block board-specific features without schema escape hatch.
conditions: Allow explicit exception list with schematic/evidence rationale.
entries.pm_reason: High-value normalization rule and low risk with controlled exceptions.

entries.rule_summary: PM summaries must include explicit "what must NOT be claimed" section when runtime blockers exist.
entries.evidence_of_benefit: Prevents RFC compile-readiness from being interpreted as runtime readiness.
entries.evidence_of_risk: Low; documentation process change only.
conditions: Gate PM summary completeness when runtime blockers are non-empty.
entries.pm_reason: Directly improves governance clarity in blocked states.

entries.rule_summary: Verifier must ensure runtime fail-closed items are unchanged unless new runtime evidence exists.
entries.evidence_of_benefit: Codifies existing fail-closed discipline and blocks silent blocker relaxation.
entries.evidence_of_risk: Low; requires robust evidence-ID linking logic.
conditions: Require evidence artifact ID and path for every blocker status transition.
entries.pm_reason: Critical for interruptible governance and runtime safety.

entries.rule_summary: Extend anti-hack detector for reset-in-hw_params and ad-hoc re-enumeration recovery logic.
entries.evidence_of_benefit: Both WCD938x learning and WCD9378 validation identify these as unsafe shortcuts.
entries.evidence_of_risk: False positives possible if patterns are too broad.
conditions: Support allowlisted exceptions only with explicit runtime waiver artifact.
entries.pm_reason: Prevents recurrence of known non-upstream runtime hacks.

entries.rule_summary: Standardize evidence checklist schema with command, output file, and acceptance criteria.
entries.evidence_of_benefit: Improves replayability and handoff quality for hardware/runtime evidence capture.
entries.evidence_of_risk: Migration overhead for existing checklists lacking schema-complete fields.
conditions: Apply schema migration with backward-compatible validator phase first.
entries.pm_reason: Strong process improvement, but rollout should avoid breaking existing artifact consumers.
